goal: Define and execute Cycle03 frontend scope by implementing 401/403 narrative auth copy in app.py, aligned with orchestration/handoff_scenarios_copy.md, while keeping current gateway auth status contract and debug visibility intact.

inputs.description: Accepted cycle02 canonical baseline and cycle03 kickoff direction.
Current cycle03 board, priorities, and no-regression guidance.
Design source for 401/403 scenario copy and UX intent.

constraints.notes: Keep auth semantics unchanged (401/403 routing and payload contract). No secret exposure. Default UI must be narrative-first; raw payload remains debug-only.

acceptance: app.py _render_universe_auth_error applies narrative-first Korean copy for 401 and 403 states aligned with orchestration/handoff_scenarios_copy.md.
401 state communicates reconnect/access path (mobile or authenticated gateway) without exposing raw token jargon in default UI.
403 state communicates permission boundary using design-aligned key/door or observer-area metaphor and provides clear next guidance.
Technical JSON payload is still available only inside a debug expander for diagnostics.
Strict-gate-first evidence is attached (or clearly marked blocked) and confirms no auth-flow behavior regression.

risk.note: Copy-only changes can still regress auth UX if status-code branching or fallback wording diverges from runtime contract expectations.

next_actions: Implement and review 401/403 narrative copy changes in app.py.
Run targeted frontend/auth checks under strict-gate-first policy and collect evidence artifact paths.
Publish schema-valid result/handoff artifacts for CT cycle03 decision.
